capture_contract.comparison: Nominal H0 reference is a design input. No generalization claim.
capture_contract.handoff: sticky first pressure>50 after actual boostback cutoff, even if capture incomplete
capture_contract.reference: desired q/rate/alpha only; no r/v/fuel/actualactuator state initialization

control_contract.faulty: At actual BB cutoff, request one installed center at physical minimum throttle to track current source-bound desired fullq/rate/alpha with actual measured TVC and finite actuators. Stop power at actual fullq<=1deg and rate<=.001, or at15s/75t guards as incomplete; preserve reference tracking during finite strong shutdown tail. Then prior low-pressure RCS capture and sticky q>50 legacy handoff. No achieved-state assignment or terminal threshold relaxation.
control_contract.healthy: Exact legacy control, no reference capture.
control_contract.scope: New bounded finite pulse after RCS-only capture failed; nominal reference is a controller design input, not held-out validation or SpaceX software.

interpretation.gate: Only two accepted saved-separation repair results from this same source/environment/profile/settings open a separate fresh-ground whole stage.
interpretation.invalid_or_budget: Stop entire stage on source/profile/site/goal/environment changes, invalid record, numerical or serialization/save/restore errors, output/disk/wall breach; no retry/resume.
interpretation.new_design: Diagnose preserved artifacts, then register a new sourcebound design if needed. Trial caps do not close the restoration project.
interpretation.valid_negative: Preserve unchanged negative and finish other registered case; do not tune or rerun within this design.
interpretation.whole_success: Report Ship, Booster, deployment and whole physical success separately. No AI/allfeatures/qualification claims.

powered_capture_contract.completion: actual measured fullq/rate gate, no ideal assignment
powered_capture_contract.incomplete: record timeout/reserve/noavailablecenter and end pulse, no retry
powered_capture_contract.main_throttle: installed center physical minimum .4; do not modify hardware
powered_capture_contract.shutdown: main OFF request after pulse, reference-tracked real tail while currentgimbalcapacity>physicalRCS, actual spool not erased
powered_capture_contract.time_step: Use unchanged powered_dt when actual pulse commands power, unchanged coast_dt otherwise; shorten current step at the fixed 15s guard, never integrate ON past the guard.

purpose: Finite one-center powered reference capture at actual boostback cutoff, followed by reference-tracked actual shutdown tail and prior low-pressure RCS capture, then legacy aerodynamic/terminal guidance. All real states remain integrated. Both exact-separation cases must pass before any fresh ground-start whole mission.
retention: Keep source plans/claims/logs, original H0/O0 successes/negatives and all new outputs; archive/hash/readback/representative restore before later separately authorized cleanup. No public push, merge, Docker or worktree cleanup.
scope_limits: AI/image/symptom diagnosis/inflight approval/tower catch/arbitrary faults/qualification/develop/video are not included.
A valid original O0 negative is an admissible separation source; it is not required to have succeeded physically.
Contact is model geometry and controlled water-entry envelope only, not water response/postcontact support/real SpaceX qualification.
unchanged: Original physics/profile, mass/fuel, thrust/Isp, engine layout, RCS/flaps/gimbal authority, integration timesteps and reserve/contact/water limits.
Legacy fixed_v1 default, original v5/v7 admission and original state-mission-v1 records/registrations stay strict and unchanged.

No gains, controller limits, dt or hardware change. A new capture law uses physical signed jet torque and current inertia; its stopping-distance expression is a heuristic request, not finite-trajectory admission. Raw residual aero/gyro/main torque and saturation remain integrated.
Each stage has its own immutable plan and exclusive one-use parent/private-worker claims. No retry or resumed consumed cohort.
All consumed original/energy/terminal/allocation/tail trials are preserved; none may be rerun.

New powered_reference_capture is explicit; consumed lowq-only source5f1b13bd and its valid negative are immutable. This pulse changes actual finite thrust/fuel/translation; it is not a free attitude reset.
